description: Legal Affairs Department -  Especially the Registeration of authorized Societies under the Societies Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (a legal statute) to authorize a society's purpose and grant exemptions from specific legal provisions. It deals with regulatory matters and legal frameworks rather than government personnel, structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other administrative matters. The mention of the Prime Minister is incidental to the legal authority being exercised, not the primary focus of the content.
